name: Building
overview: Scripture emphasizes that all building efforts, whether physical structures like houses and towers or spiritual edifices like the church, must be founded upon the Lord’s guidance and blessing to be truly successful, as Psalms 127:1 and Matthew 7:24 illustrate. Wisdom and understanding are essential for establishing a house (Proverbs 24:3), while careful planning and counting the cost are necessary before undertaking construction (Luke 14:28). The Lord’s pleasure and glory are connected to building His house (Haggai 1:8), and Christ Himself promises to build His church on a firm foundation that no evil can overcome (Matthew 16:18). These verses collectively reveal both literal and figurative dimensions of building under God’s sovereign direction.
